tools.name: get_catchup
tools.description: Today's catch-up: mix by horizon, new views, flips, and divergence. Mix is a count. Headge has no house view.

tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Today's placed views (US session day, ET), newest first, split Bullish / Bearish. Neutral sits under the split. Publication day, not forecast horizon.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Current attributed views on one topic in the closed catalog (for example gold, inflation, xlk).

tools.name: get_analyst
tools.description: Current attributed views and catch-up for one talking head, by slug (for example lyn-alden).

tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: Attributed views that name this ticker, plus related views labelled as Headge's mapping.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Analysts, topics, and instruments Headge tracks. Use this to resolve names before other tools.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Resolve a query to analysts, topics, and instruments.

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: One attributed view by id, with source URL for citation.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
